results.text: Nimodipine attenuates neuroinflammation and delayed apoptotic neuronal death induced by trimethyltin in the dentate gyrus of mice. L-type voltage-gated calcium channels (L-VGCCs) are thought to be involved in epileptogenesis and acute excitotoxicity. However, little is known about the role of L-VGCCs in neuroinflammation or delayed neuronal death following excitotoxic insult.
